title: absinthium vulgare
intro: Absinthium vulgare, commonly known as wormwood, is a perennial plant native to Europe and North Africa, known for its bitter and astringent properties. The health benefits of wormwood include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which can help to treat digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of wormwood include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and soothe nervous system irritability. The bioactive constituents of wormwood include thujone, alpha-pinene, and borneol, which are responsible for its bioactive properties and medicinal uses.
